name: Ohana Beach House
about: A relaxed home base for the group: start in the private pool, gather for meals outdoors, then head to the nearby beach.
highlightsText: The private pool, outdoor dining space, and nearby beach make this an easy home base for the whole crew.
worthKnowing: The beach is nearby, but walking access is not confirmed.

name: Big Island Beach Retreat
about: A bright stay for pool time and outdoor meals, with wifi and a big kitchen for the whole group.
highlightsText: A private pool, outdoor dining, wifi, and a big kitchen keep beach days simple for everyone.
worthKnowing: Closest grocery stop is a short drive from the house.

name: Aloha Coast Retreat
about: Coastal calm with a private pool, reliable wifi, air conditioning, and space to cook together.
highlightsText: Private pool, wifi, air conditioning, and a big kitchen make this an easy coast-side reset.
worthKnowing: Evening temperatures drop — the AC keeps rooms comfortable overnight.

name: Honolulu Oceanfront Home
about: Oceanfront evenings around the fire pit and hot tub, with outdoor dining steps from the beach.
highlightsText: Outdoor dining, beach access, a fire pit, and a hot tub make this an easy oceanfront hangout.
worthKnowing: Street parking fills up on weekends — arrive early if you drive.

name: Sunset Beach House
about: A fire pit and hot tub favorite, with air conditioning and a big kitchen for long North Shore days.
highlightsText: Fire pit, hot tub, air conditioning, and a big kitchen cover sunset hangs and late dinners.
worthKnowing: Surf conditions change quickly — check local guidance before swimming.

name: Oceanfront Maui Home
about: Near the beach with a private pool, fire pit, and air conditioning throughout the home.
highlightsText: Private pool, beach proximity, a fire pit, and air conditioning keep Maui days easy.
worthKnowing: Resort area quiet hours start at 10pm around the outdoor spaces.
